connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source: A connection to the Xero REST API
connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.message: A connection to the Xero REST API

connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source:
A connection to [Xero](https://www.xero.com) for contacts, invoices, payments, bank transactions, quotes, projects and payroll employees.

**Authentication** is the OAuth2 authorization code flow with `oauth2_client_id` and `oauth2_client_secret` from an app registered in the Xero developer portal. The `offline_access` scope is requested by default, without which the connection stops working when the access token expires.

**`tenant_id` names the organisation.** A Xero credential can reach several organisations and every call has to say which one it means, so the tenant belongs here rather than to each action - a connection is a connection to one organisation's books. It is filled in automatically when the connection is authorized, from `GET /connections` - which lists what the credential can reach and is also the ping.

**`payroll_region`** selects the payroll API: Australia is served at `payroll.xro/1.0` and New Zealand and the United Kingdom at `payroll.xro/2.0`, which are different API versions rather than the same one at different addresses.

Xero is a trademark of Xero Limited.

connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source: Which regional payroll API to use
connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.message: Which regional payroll API to use

connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source:
Which regional payroll API the employee actions use.

Xero has no single payroll API: Australia is served at `payroll.xro/1.0` and New Zealand and the United Kingdom at `payroll.xro/2.0`, and the two versions differ in what they accept. Leave this unset for an organisation that does not use Xero payroll; the employee actions then report that no region is set rather than guessing one.

connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source: The Xero organisation this connection works in
connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.message: The Xero organisation this connection works in

connection.WGVyb1Jlc3RDbGllbnQ.scheme.WG.source:
The ID of the Xero organisation this connection works in, sent as `Xero-Tenant-Id` with every call.

**This is filled in automatically** when the connection is authorized, so it normally needs no attention. A credential can reach several organisations, and a call that does not name one is rejected; the first organisation `GET /connections` lists is used, and the others are logged. Set this to work in one of those instead - a value set here is never overwritten.
